name: OfficeLove -Cool na Senpai-Kanojo to Himitsu no "Iki-nuki"-
original_name: OfficeLove -クールな先輩彼女と秘密のイキ抜き-
source:
The protagonist finally lands a job that he wanted at a major company. Sometimes he makes mistake, but everyone recognizes his genuine commitment to his work.

Especially, the girl who is in charge of his training and likes to dote on him, Kaminokura Maika. Because she always takes care of him, the protagonist has a crush on her.

Due to a certain event, they start dating each other.

Girlfriend and boyfriend.
A superior and a subordinate.

While hiding their "true relationship," on business trip at a hotel, or sometimes at the office, the two of them secretly nurturing their love.

Thus, a sweet and exciting adult romance begins.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1354827]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主角终于在一家大公司找到了他想要的工作。有时他会犯错误，但每个人都认可他对工作的真诚承诺。

尤其是负责他的训练、非常宠爱他的女孩——上仓舞花。因为她总是照顾他，所以主角对她产生了好感。

由于某件事，他们开始约会。

女朋友和男朋友。
一个是上级，一个是下级。

两人在隐藏“真实关系”的同时，出差在酒店，有时在办公室，也暗暗培育着爱情。

于是，一段甜蜜又刺激的成人恋情开始了。

[翻译和编辑自 [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1354827]Getchu[/url]]
